newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada dollar closes stronger on trade numbers.
newsitem.headline: Canada dollar closes stronger on trade numbers.

text.p: Canada's dollar closed stronger at C$1.3485 (US$0.7416) on Friday from Thursday's close of C$1.3512 (US$0.7401), gathering momentum on strong Canadian trade data, dealers said.
Canada's trade surplus widened to a record C$4.02 billion in August from C$2.89 billion in July, Statistics Canada said Friday.
The currency also gained strength after this week's Bank of Canada cut in short-term interest rates, dealers said.
"It became inevitable the Canada would rally," said Reid Farrill, foreign exchange specialist at CIBC.
